title: Hot pot restaurant in Spring Valley (Chinatown, unincorporated Clark County)

input.where: 5115 Spring Mountain Rd, Spring Valley, NV 89146

assumptions: The company still has to be formed (an LLC) unless an entity is named. Hires staff. Builds out the space. No new exterior sign (signage: false).

items.name: State Business License (with the LLC formation)
items.note: Retailers "must have a Business License (NRS 372.220)" before the tax permit.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Unemployment insurance employer registration
items.agency: Nevada Department of Employment, Training and Rehabilitation (Employment Security Division)

items.name: Food establishment plan review
items.match: (plan review).*(southern nevada health district)|(southern nevada health district).*(plan review)

items.name: Food establishment health permit
items.match: (health permit).*(southern nevada health district)|(southern nevada health district).*(health permit)

items.name: Food Safety Training Cards for employees
items.match: (food handler|food safety training card).*(southern nevada health district)|(southern nevada health district).*(food handler|food safety training card)

items.name: Certified Food Safety Manager (person in charge)
items.match: (certified food (safety|protection) manager|food manager).*(southern nevada health district)|(southern nevada health district).*(certified food (safety|protection) manager|food manager)

items.name: Clark County business license
items.match: (clark county business licen|business licen).*(clark county)|(clark county).*(clark county business licen|business licen)
items.quote: Proof that you have applied with the Southern Nevada Health District (SNHD).
items.note: For unincorporated Clark County; apply within 30 days of opening.

items.name: Workers' compensation insurance
items.agency: Nevada Division of Industrial Relations, Workers' Compensation Section
items.note: Added in the verification pass of 2026-10-23 (src/forms/verify.ts), when the registry row got its proof.
items.quote: NRS 616B.633 Applicability to all employers who employ at least one employee.

order.why: Plans approved before construction; the permit after the final inspection.

mustNotInclude.name: City of Las Vegas business license
mustNotInclude.why: The Strip and Spring Valley are unincorporated Clark County.
mustNotInclude.match: city of las vegas business license|lv-license
